title: Park Hyatt Brisbane to Make Its Queensland Debut on the Riverfront

body_markdown:
**CHICAGO** **(November 18, 2026) –** Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announces plans for the first Park Hyatt-branded hotel in Brisbane. Projected to open in 2031, the property will be developed in collaboration with the Shayher Group. Park Hyatt Brisbane will mark the debut of the Park Hyatt brand in the state of Queensland and offer guests an outstanding stay and access to global economic hub, cultural center and travel destination that Brisbane has become.


On the shores of Brisbane River, at the western edge of the city’s central business district, Park Hyatt Brisbane will occupy the top floors of one of the two towers of 309 North Quay, a mixed-used development also containing luxury homes and retail outlets. The hotel will feature 201 guest rooms and suites all offering uninterrupted river and skyline views, along with 50 serviced apartments suitable for extended residence.


*“The Park Hyatt calling cards have always been iconic design and extraordinary addresses. Brisbane has the confidence and growing global pull to make it a natural home for the brand. When it opens, Park Hyatt Brisbane will become the fifth Park Hyatt hotel in the Pacific, joining hotels in Sydney, Melbourne, Canberra and Auckland, and a deliberate next step in growing the brand in the right places.”*


— Tamara Lohan, Global Brand Leader – Luxury, Hyatt


Beside the William Jolly Bridge, it will be ideally located for business and leisure travelers, with easy access to Brisbane’s business district, as well as major attractions including Suncorp Stadium (Lang Park), the City Botanic Gardens, the Gallery of Modern Art and the Queensland Cultural Centre.


*“We are proud to collaborate with Hyatt to bring the Park Hyatt brand to Brisbane as part of 309 North Quay. The brand’s residential-inspired approach to luxury is a natural complement to our vision of creating a premium destination for urban living, lifestyle and hospitality. Park Hyatt Brisbane will be an integral part of this mix, while introducing the next level of luxury to the city’s hospitality offering.”*


– John Lin, Group Director, Shayher Group


Australia’s third largest city, Brisbane is a key global economic centre with a rapidly evolving cultural scene and a thriving tourism industry. In 2032, Brisbane will come under the global spotlight as never before, as it plays host to athletes from around the world and welcomes thousands of visitors from around the world—and, just a few minutes’ walk from one of the key venues, Lang Park, Park Hyatt Brisbane will be waiting to greet them.


“ *Park Hyatt Brisbane will mark another milestone in Hyatt’s expansion of its brands across key destinations. We are delighted to collaborate with Shayher to introduce the brand to Queensland, in the heart of its capital. As the planned location of the fifth Park Hyatt destination in the Pacific region, Brisbane reflects the city’s growing importance as a global hub for business, culture and events. We see an opportunity to contribute to its continued evolution with a hotel that brings the brand’s distinctive residential-style luxury and intuitive service to the city.”*


– Stephen Ho, President, Greater China and Growth, Asia Pacific, Hyatt


*The term “Hyatt” is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.*


**About Park Hyatt**


The Park Hyatt legacy spans over 45 years of being the luxury choice for discerning global travelers, offering refined and exceptional accommodations in the world’s most desirable cities and resort destinations. Each property is thoughtfully designed to deliver residentially inspired elegance through architecture, housed world-class art, and curated immersive culinary experiences—all complemented by an intuitively personalized level of service. Guests enjoy carefully appointed rooms, acclaimed design, and signature restaurants led by award-winning chefs—creating experiences as personal as they are memorable. **About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of September 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 84 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the *Luxury Portfolio* , including ***Park Hyatt*** ®, ***Alila*** ®, ***Miraval*** ®, ***Impression by Secrets*** , and ***The Unbound Collection by Hyatt*** ®; the *Lifestyle Portfolio* , including ***Andaz*** ®, ***Thompson Hotels*** ®, ***The Standard*** ®, ***Dream*** ® ***Hotels*** , ***The StandardX*** ®, ***Breathless Resorts & Spas*** ®, ***JdV by Hyatt*** ®, ***Bunkhouse*** ® ***Hotels*** , and ***Me and All Hotels*** ; the *Inclusive Collection* , including ***Zoëtry*** ® ***Wellness & Spa Resorts*** , ***Hyatt Ziva*** ®, ***Hyatt Zilara*** ®, ***Secrets*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Dreams*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** , ***Hyatt Vivid*** ® ***Hotels & Resorts*** , ***Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts*** ®, and ***Sunscape*** ® ***Resorts & Spas*** *;* the *Classics Portfolio* , including ***Grand Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Regency*** ®, ***Destination by Hyatt*** ®, ***Hyatt Centric*** ®, ***Hyatt Vacation Club*** ®, and ***Hyatt*** ®; and the *Essentials Portfolio* , including ***Caption by Hyatt*** ®, **Unscripted by Hyatt** ®, ***Hyatt Place*** ®, ***Hyatt House*** ®, ***Hyatt Studios*** ®, **Hyatt Select** ® **,** and ***UrCove*** . Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith®, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit *www.hyatt.com* .


**About Shayher Group**


Since 1999, Shayher Group has grown into a diversified Australian property group focused on creating places that foster connection, community and long-term value. Headquartered in Brisbane, its portfolio spans Queensland, New South Wales and Victoria, encompassing property development, investment and asset ownership across a diverse range of sectors. At the heart of the business are the people it works with, the places it helps shape and the projects it proudly delivers. Every investment is guided by a commitment to quality, commercial strength, and enduring outcomes for partners, residents, tenants and communities.
